Quaternius building assets - provenance notice

The four OBJ/MTL pairs in this directory are:

- 1Story_GableRoof.obj / 1Story_GableRoof.mtl
- 2Story_GableRoof.obj / 2Story_GableRoof.mtl
- 2Story_Wide.obj / 2Story_Wide.mtl
- 2Story_RoundRoof.obj / 2Story_RoundRoof.mtl

Quaternius publishes its free building packs with OBJ files and a CC0
license. The candidate official pack pages checked on 2026-09-08 are:

- Buildings Pack: https://quaternius.com/packs/buildings.html
- Simple Buildings Pack: https://quaternius.com/packs/simplebuildings.html

Both pages declare CC0-1.0 and OBJ distribution. Their currently published
Google Drive archives use different filenames, so the exact local file-to-pack
match has not been proven. This notice intentionally records that limitation;
it must not be read as a claim that the source archive was identified.

The upstream site license page, last updated 2026-08-28, now describes the
Quaternius Asset License rather than CC0:
https://quaternius.com/license.html

Because these files were already present before this notice was added, the
download date and the license version that applied on that date are not known
from repository evidence. Resolve the exact source archive and applicable
license before claiming release-grade legal clearance.

2026-10-20 follow-up:

The public Google Drive OBJ folders linked from both candidate pages were
checked:

- Buildings Pack (Jan 2019): Building1_Large.obj, Building1_Small.obj,
  Building2_Large.obj, Building2_Small.obj, Building3_Big.obj,
  Building3_Small.obj, Building4.obj, House1.obj, House2.obj.
- Simple Buildings Pack (Aug 2017): Bank.obj, Flat.obj, Flat2.obj,
  Hospital.obj, House.obj, House2.obj, House3.obj, House4.obj, House5.obj,
  Shop.obj.

Neither list contains 1Story_GableRoof, 2Story_GableRoof, 2Story_Wide or
2Story_RoundRoof. The local files therefore do not match either published pack
listing and their exact Quaternius pack/archive remains unknown. Both candidate
pages declare CC0, but that cannot be transferred to these unproven local files.
